_comment: GitHub ruleset that closes the release path on main: a pull request is required,
and both the release gate (which rejects a head branch other than preview) and CI
must pass. Together that means main only ever advances through preview.
It cannot be applied from a Claude Code session — writes to GitHub's
administration API paths are blocked at the sandbox proxy — so it lives here as a
reviewable payload. Apply it with a PAT that has `repo` scope:
Or by hand: Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New branch ruleset, target the default
branch, and tick 'Require a pull request before merging' plus those two status checks.
Note there is no bypass actor, so it applies to the repository owner too. To keep an
The two contexts below are the *job names* of the workflows, which is what GitHub
reports as the check name. Rename a job and this ruleset must be updated with it, or
main becomes unmergeable while it waits for a check that never reports.
name: main: release path only (preview -> main)

required_status_checks.context: A PR into main must come from preview
